Learn More

FanClub Holiday Movie Pass

Get ready for the holidays with 4 months of perks, free movie tickets, and so much more!

OFFER TERMS AND CONDITIONS The “FanClub Holiday Movie Pass” offer (the “Offer”) begins November 1, 2026 and will run through December 31, 2026 (the “Offer Period”). Eligible Customers that redeem the Offer will receive, subject to these terms (the “Offer Benefit(s)”): a four-month FanClub Holiday Movie Pass subscription for $49.99 + tax, four (4) movie ticket promotional codes, and one (1) $20 Fandango Stream promotional code. Eligible Customers: new customers (no active FanClub membership at the time) that subscribe to a Qualifying Membership during the Offer Period (“New Member(s)”) and individuals whose paid FanClub membership has expired before Offer redemption and before the end of the Offer Period (“Eligible Lapsed Member(s)”) only. Eligible Lapsed Members must subscribe to the Qualifying Membership while logged in to the Fandango account associated with their lapsed paid FanClub membership. Qualifying Membership: FanClub Holiday Movie Pass subscribed through Offer Checkout. Credit card required. With Offer applied, you will be charged $49.99 + tax for your Qualifying Membership. After four (4) months from the date of purchase (the “Offer Term”), your Qualifying Membership will automatically renew monthly at the then-current full price, currently $9.99 + tax/month, until cancelled. Prices subject to change. Cancel before end of Offer Term to avoid future charges. To cancel, go to the FanClub Membership Dashboard in your account settings and click “Cancel Membership”. If your Qualifying Membership includes a free trial and you cancel before being charged, you will not be eligible for the Offer or receive Offer Benefit(s). See FanClub Program Terms. Offer Checkout: visit www.fandango.com/fanclub/single/holidaypass. Offer will be automatically applied during Offer Checkout. To redeem, you must complete your Qualifying Membership subscription through the Offer Checkout while Offer is applied. Offer not available through any purchase path other than the Offer Checkout. Four (4) movie ticket promotional codes (each, a “Ticket Code” and collectively, the “Ticket Codes”) and one (1) Fandango Stream promotional code (the “Stream Code” and, collectively with the Ticket Codes, the “Promo Code(s)”) will be sent in separate fulfillment emails. One (1) Ticket Code and the Stream Code will be sent within 24 to 48 hours after Offer redemption; the remaining three (3) Ticket Codes will be sent monthly over the following three months. Each Ticket Code discounts the retail price of one (1) movie ticket on Fandango to $0.00 (taxes or fees may be excluded). The Stream Code provides $20 off one (1) movie or episode purchase on Fandango Stream. Promo Code(s) expire on the earlier of 04/30/2027 or when your FanClub membership expires, require an active paid FanClub membership at redemption, and are one-time use only. See the emails containing the Promo Code(s) for additional instructions and terms. Offer Benefit(s) may not cover the total cost of your transaction; you are responsible for paying any amounts remaining after Offer Benefit(s) are applied (including taxes and fees). Any unused portions of the Offer Benefit(s) will be forfeited upon redemption. If redemption transaction is cancelled or refunded, eligibility for Offer may be forfeited. Offer Benefit(s) will not be refunded. Adjustments to prior purchases not permitted. Taxes may apply. Offer, Offer Benefit(s), and Promo Code(s): (a) are limited to one per person or Fandango account; (b) are only redeemable on the Fandango or Fandango Stream website or mobile app, as applicable (“Fandango”), while logged in to your account; (c) are not redeemable at any theater or third-party directly; (d) are non-transferable, are not for resale, and have no cash value; (e) cannot be combined with any other offers or promotional codes, except as expressly stated in these terms; (f) are void if sold, transferred, or exchanged; (g) cannot be replaced if lost or stolen; and (h) are valid only in the fifty (50) United States, D.C., and Puerto Rico, excluding other U.S. territories. Void where prohibited. Fandango reserves the right to withdraw or modify this Offer at any time, in its sole discretion, and without notice. Additional terms and conditions apply, including Fandango’s Terms and Policies.
